pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.12
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a graphics glitch that could cause a corrupted/garbled screen on startup on some Windows setups (DirectX rendering issue).
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.13
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]✨ New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards now show the full player list, page by page - click a player's photo to view their Steam profile.
[/list]
[h3]🎨 Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redesigned the Crafting tab for better usability.
[*] Refreshed several in-game assets and icons.
[*] Crafting now shows a clear "in progress" state and displays the item you just received, with less waiting.
[/list]
[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed several Steamworks Inventory sync issues that could prevent Collection/Crafting items from loading or displaying correctly.
[*] Fixed the Golden Pizza sometimes not registering clicks.
[*] Fixed the Craft button getting stuck if a craft attempt failed.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.14
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Halloween event from October 20 to November 3: spooky night theme, a pumpkin Golden Pizza, and Golden Pizzas show up more often.
[*] 4 limited Halloween items in the Pizza Box: Pumpkin Slice, Pumpkin Pizza, Skeleton Rider, Haunted Plane.
[*] New "Random" option for delivery drivers and planes in the Collection: a different skin every time.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Ovens, restaurants and factories redrawn in pixel art, with animated smoke and lights.
[*] New pixel art and animations for the default, Gold, Tokyo Night and S1 scooters and the Electro Plane.
[*] New, smaller Golden Pizza.
[*] Cleaner screen: building counters and level labels removed.
[*] The default cursor now shows its real look in the Collection.
[*] Updated Steam inventory icons for several scooters and the Electro Plane.
[*] Lots of behind-the-scenes cleanup for a more stable game.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Season 2 items that could not be used in crafting.
[*] Fixed some rare items missing from the rare crafting recipe.
[*] Fixed the S1 Plane skin not displaying.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.15
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pizza Empire is now available on Linux and Steam Deck, natively.
[*] Supporter Pack DLC: 4 exclusive gold items (Supporter Slice, Diamond Pizza, VIP Rider, Golden Jet) and a Supporter badge on the leaderboard. Cosmetic only. The game stays free, with no ads.
[*] Leaderboard: your own rank is now always shown at the bottom.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Much lighter game: capped at 60 FPS and slowed down when the window is in the background. Less CPU, less battery.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Update v2.16
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leaderboard: switching pages quickly no longer shows an empty page or only your own name.
[*] Collection: your items no longer disappear after a Pizza Box drop or when the Supporter Pack items are granted.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Collection: the Supporter Pack items are now shown in dimmed gold until you own them.
[/list]

pending.title: Pizza Empire - Hotfix v2.17
pending.author: bando ✮
pending.contents:
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leaderboard: the Supporter badge now also shows next to other players, not only next to your own name.
[/list]
